name: Goodberry
description: A plump berry humming with druidic magic, conjured by the Goodberry spell. One is a mouthful of summer and a day's worth of nourishment.
notes: Eat to heal 1d4+1 HP and stay fed for 4 hours, in or out of combat.
In combat it uses your action.
Its magic fades after a day: the berries are gone.
Made by the Goodberry spell; merchants won't pay for it.
